description: This file defines a class that ensures the 'type' attribute for <script> tags is set to 'text/javascript' if not already specified. It is part of the HTMLPurifier library's attribute transformation system.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_ScriptRequired
classes.description: A class that enforces the 'type' attribute for <script> tags to be 'text/javascript' if not already set.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Sets the 'type' attribute to 'text/javascript' if it is not already present.
